title: let read-only roles use a shell variable for the worktree path, or say in the brief that such commands are denied

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-014727-adb2, project ork, item S307:

let read-only roles use a shell variable for the worktree path, or say in the brief that such commands are denied

Evidence: last round, a Bash call with F=path then grep $F was denied: "A variable in this command can't be checked before it runs"
